0022600191.text: The New York Knicks (4-4, 7th in the East, 3rd in the Atlantic and 3.5 games back) visit the Cleveland Cavaliers (4-4, 6th in the East, 2nd in the Central and 2 games back) in the Knicks' ninth game of the 2026-27 season, with New York on a two-game winning streak and Cleveland on a two-game losing streak. Knicks guard Josh Hart is listed as day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision, averaging 8.6 points and 31.7 minutes per game this season after 12.0 and 30.2 last season. The teams have not yet met in 2026-27, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1 and swept the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, most recently beating Cleveland 130-93 in Cleveland in a playoff game on May 25.
